title: Vanguard Enterprise nonprofit for UAP whistleblowers

tellings.quote: Enterprise. Vanguard for short. It's a uh nonprofit that uh Dylan Borland and myself have started and uh Jeffrey Nusatelli has now joined.
I'm allin. Um, the idea is to help whistleblowers and their families medically, financially, spiritually, emotionally.
tellings.difference: Told by Borland rather than Brown, and lists the aims as medical, financial, spiritual and emotional help for whistleblowers and their families.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the Vanguard nonprofit that Borland and Matthew Brown started to support UAP whistleblowers, which Jeff Nuccetelli has joined.

plain: Matthew Brown, presented as a former Pentagon insider turned whistleblower, told Jesse Michels in 2026 that he and a man named Dylan Borland started a nonprofit called Vanguard Enterprise, or Vanguard for short. He says another man, Jeffrey Nusatelli, has now joined. It is meant to support whistleblowers on UAP, the government's term for UFOs, meaning unidentified anomalous phenomena.
